title: DeepConvContext: A Multi-Scale Approach to Timeseries Classification in Human Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2505.20894v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite recognized limitations in modeling long-range temporal dependencies, Human Activity Recognition (HAR) has traditionally relied on a sliding window approach to segment labeled datasets. Deep learning models like the DeepConvLSTM typically classify each window independently, restricting learnable temporal context to within-window information and producing fragmented, temporally incoherent activity timelines. To address this constraint, we propose DeepConvContext, a multi-scale time series classification framework for HAR. Drawing inspiration from the vision-based Temporal Action Localization community, DeepConvContext models both intra- and inter-window temporal patterns separately by processing sequences of time-ordered windows. Across six widely-used HAR benchmarks, DeepConvContext achieves an average 5% improvement in F1-score and up to 18-point improvement in mAP over related approaches, while achieving latency and throughp

translated_title: DeepConvContext：一种用于人类活动识别中时间序列分类的多尺度方法
translated_abstract: 尽管公认在建模长期时间依赖性方面存在局限性，但人类活动识别（HAR）传统上依赖滑动窗口方法来分割标记数据集。像DeepConvLSTM这样的深度学习模型通常独立分类每个窗口，将可学习的时间上下文限制在窗口内信息，并产生碎片化、时间上不连贯的活动时间线。为解决这一限制，我们提出了DeepConvContext，一种用于HAR的多尺度时间序列分类框架。受基于视觉的时序动作定位社区的启发，DeepConvContext通过处理时间有序窗口序列，分别建模窗口内和窗口间的时间模式。在六个广泛使用的HAR基准测试中，DeepConvContext在F1分数上平均提高了5%，在mAP上比相关方法提高了最多18个百分点，同时实现了低延迟和高吞吐量。
tldr: 本文提出DeepConvContext框架，通过多尺度建模窗口内和窗口间时间模式，显著提升了人类活动识别中的时间序列分类性能，平均F1分数提高5%，mAP提升最多18点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DeepConvContext, a multi-scale framework that separately models intra- and inter-window temporal patterns, achieving an average 5% F1-score improvement and up to 18-point mAP gain in human activity recognition.
